subject: English
question_text: Write a paragraph on ‘Traffic Jam’ following the questions below. The pagraph should not exceed
stimulus: words. 10 (a) What is traffic jam? (b) Where does it occur generally? (c) When does it occur? (d) Why does it occur? (e) What are the real causes of it? (f) What are effects of it in the society? (g) How can we over come the odd situation? (h) What necessary measure should be taken by the Government to dismiss the problem?
